title: S1000XR M Competition (Explorer Pack)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the BMW Motorrad S1000XR M Competition (Explorer Pack) is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 1000cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 228 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
